# Analog From Here

> A resource for analog enthusiasts exploring intentional living through bullet journaling, fountain pens, and analog photography.

Analog From Here provides practical guides, personal experiences, and recommendations for adopting analog tools and systems. The site focuses on bullet journaling as a productivity method, fountain pen culture, analog photography, and the philosophy of pen-and-paper planning for intentional living.

## Key Topics

- Bullet Journal
- Monthly Log
- Analog Planning
- Productivity System
- Journaling
- Fountain Pens
- Intentional Living
- Planning Methods
- Handwriting
- Analog Writing
- Organization
- Traveler's Notebook
- Rhodia
- Tomoe River
- Pen and Paper

## Bullet Journal System

- [Learn more about the Bullet Journal](https://analogfromhere.com/journaling-planning/bullet-journal): Collection of articles on Bullet Journal system for productivity and intentional living.
- [Bullet Journal Monthly Log: 8 Practical Tips for Better Organization](https://analogfromhere.com/mastering-the-bullet-journal-monthly-logs): 8 practical techniques for creating effective Bullet Journal monthly logs and layouts.
- [Bujo Basics: Monthly Log and Some Layout Ideas](https://analogfromhere.com/bujo-basics-monthly-log): Bullet Journal basics: monthly log design, purpose, and practical layout ideas.

## Fountain Pens & Writing

- [I thought my fountain pen would improve my handwriting...](https://analogfromhere.com/writing-with-a-fountain-pen-did-not-improve-my-handwriting): Personal experience on handwriting improvement through practice, not fountain pens.
- [Fountain pen friendly notebooks that aren't Rhodia or Tomoe River](https://analogfromhere.com/fountain-pen-friendly-notebooks-that-arent-rhodia-or-tomoe-river): Alternative fountain pen friendly notebook recommendations beyond Rhodia and Tomoe River.

## Analog Tools & Notebooks

- [Bullet Journalling in a Traveler's Notebook](https://analogfromhere.com/why-i-moved-my-bullet-journal-to-a-travelers-notebook): Personal account of migrating Bullet Journal from A5 notebook to Traveler's Notebook.

## Analog Photography

- [Best film cameras for digital photographers: Your perfect analog match](https://analogfromhere.com/types-of-film-cameras-and-their-digital-counterparts): Guide matching film cameras to digital photography styles for analog photography.
